claim.quote: This is the first detection of photons with $E>100$ TeV from an astrophysical source.

key_value_text.quote: we observed 24 photon-like events with $E>100$ TeV against 5.5 background events
key_value_text.value: 24 photon-like events with E > 100 TeV against 5.5 background events

name: First detection of photons above 100 TeV from an astrophysical source

official_url.quote: First Detection of Photons with Energy Beyond 100 TeV from an Astrophysical Source

summary.plain: Using underground muon detectors to reject cosmic-ray showers, the Tibet array picked out 24 gamma-ray-like events above 100 TeV from the Crab Nebula. The collaboration says this is the first detection of photons that energetic from any astrophysical source.
summary.technical: Tibet air-shower array with the underground water-Cherenkov muon-detector array: 99.92% of cosmic-ray background above 100 TeV suppressed by the muon criterion; 24 photon-like events with E > 100 TeV against 5.5 background events from the Crab Nebula, 5.6 sigma.

title: First Detection of Photons with Energy Beyond 100 TeV from an Astrophysical Source
why_it_matters: The abstract says this is the first detection of photons above 100 TeV from an astrophysical source, using the muon number in an air shower to suppress 99.92% of the cosmic-ray background.
